summary: Simplified command execution by passing augmented PATH to PTY at spawn time. Previously, every command needed to set PATH with all directories (Node.js, Git, npm, etc.) because the terminal was spawned with process.env which didn't include these paths. Now: 1) PTY is spawned with getAugmentedEnv() which includes all necessary paths, 2) Commands no longer need PATH prefix for default method, 3) Commands are now much shorter: 'claude --dangerously-skip-permissions' instead of 'cd /d "..." && set "PATH=..." && "claude" --dangerously-skip-permissions'
current_status: Commands are now much simpler. PTY spawns with correct PATH including Node.js from NVM4W.
